9ca2d90cc88efe10.description: We are looking for an IT Manager to manage our IT operations within our Workplace department. In this role, you will manage end-to-end IT infrastructure and support operations, while developing and implementing strategies to ensure an efficient working environment. At Dream Games, all team members have a genuine chance to contribute to the final product and have an impact on the company. If you want to be a team member of a fast-growing company, you might be the person we are looking for!
